description: A free fake REST API (jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) with posts and users. Demonstrates CRUD-style steps and passing data between steps via memory.

listPosts.description: GET /posts — lists posts, optionally filtered by user.

input.name: query.userId
input.description: Only return posts authored by this user (1-10).

listPosts.example:
application: jsonplaceholder
method: listPosts
parameters:
  query:
    userId: 1
test:
  status: 200
  body: "$expr: Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 10"

output.description: The post object. Unknown ids return 404.

getPost.example:
application: jsonplaceholder
method: getPost
parameters:
  params:
    id: 1
test:
  status: 200
  body:
    id: 1
    userId: 1

createPost.description: POST /posts — creates a post (the fake API answers 201 with the new id, but does not persist it).

output.description: The created post, including the id assigned by the API.

memory.description: The id of the created post. Later steps can read it with {{ memory.lastPostId }}.

createPost.example:
application: jsonplaceholder
method: createPost
parameters:
  body:
    title: "{{ randomString }}"
    body: "Written by {{ randomName }}"
    userId: 1
test:
  status: 201

output.description: The user object with address and company details.

getUser.example:
application: jsonplaceholder
method: getUser
parameters:
  params:
    id: 1
test:
  status: 200
  body:
    id: 1
